title: Non-supersymmetric dualities beyond the gauge algebra
summary: We provide a testing ground for dualities of non-supersymmetric type 0 orientifolds by finding the global forms of their gauge groups. As an example, we consider the Bergman--Gaberdiel proposal for a duality of theories with $\mathfrak{so}(32) \oplus \mathfrak{so}(32)$ gauge algebra. On the orientifold side, we perform a scan of brane states, similar to the case of the D0-brane in type I string theory, and identify spinorial states that constrain the gauge group.
